title: The Measurement Revolution? Credible Measurement and Inference in the Age of AI
abstract: arXiv:2608.23524v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming measurement in economics. AI models convert unstructured data, such as text and images, into structured variables at low cost, making previously prohibitive measurement feasible at scale. This shifts the bottleneck from finding any scalable measure of a phenomenon to choosing among many plausible ones, which may support different empirical conclusions. This review provides guidance for navigating that shift. We describe three stages at which AI enters the measurement pipeline---discovery, construct definition, and observation---and what each demands of researchers. We argue that credible inference with AI-generated variables requires appropriately designed validation: anchoring measurement to explicit criteria, rather than informal claims that a proxy is reasonable. translated_title: 测量革命？人工智能时代的可信测量与推断
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23524v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：人工智能正在转变经济学中的测量方式。AI模型能够以低成本将文本和图像等非结构化数据转换为结构化变量，使得以前难以实现的测量在大规模上变得可行。这使瓶颈从寻找某种现象的任意可扩展测量转变为在众多可能方案中进行选择，而这些方案可能支持不同的实证结论。本综述为应对这一转变提供指导。我们描述了AI进入测量流程的三个阶段——发现、构念定义和观察——以及每个阶段对研究者的要求。我们认为，对AI生成变量进行可信推断需要适当设计的验证：将测量锚定于明确标准，而非对代理指标合理性的非正式声称。然后，我们探讨了即使AI预测存在任意偏差，验证样本如何支持有效推断，以及可以采取哪些措施。
tldr: 本文综述了AI如何改变经济学测量，强调通过明确标准验证AI生成变量以确保可信推断，即使AI预测存在偏差。
en_tdlr: This review examines how AI transforms measurement in economics, emphasizing validation against explicit criteria for credible inference with AI-generated variables, even under arbitrary biases.
